meta.name: Malviya Dental Clinic — Treatment Page Layout System (Clove-style anatomy)
meta.purpose: This file defines the CONTENT STRUCTURE and LAYOUT PATTERN for treatment pages (dental-implant, teeth-whitening, braces, etc.), modeled on the anatomy of https://clovedental.in/specialties/dental-implant — NOT modeled on our own landing page's layout. Visual identity (colors, fonts, spacing tokens, shadows, radius) must still come from the clinic's existing style.css. The goal: same brand skin, different page anatomy than the homepage, closer to a long-form educational treatment article.
meta.critical_instruction: Do NOT reuse the homepage's section layout (hero-with-slider -> stats -> service-grid -> doctor-card -> steps -> testimonials -> faq -> contact). This page has its own anatomy defined in page_anatomy below, which is longer, more text-driven, and structured like an in-depth medical explainer with a sticky sidebar CTA, not a marketing landing page.
meta.visual_identity_source: Reuse ALL existing CSS custom properties, font families, base font sizes, shadows, radii from style.css (--dark-navy, --bright-blue, --font-heading, --font-body, --shadow, --radius, etc.). Do not introduce new colors or fonts.
meta.new_classes_policy: It is expected and encouraged to ADD new component classes to the existing style.css for structures the homepage doesn't have (e.g. .article-section, .pros-cons-table, .procedure-stage, .cost-card, .aftercare-list, .reviewed-badge). Append these under a clearly commented block, e.g. /* ===== TREATMENT ARTICLE PAGE COMPONENTS ===== */. Reuse existing buttons, faq accordion (details/summary pattern), modals, header, footer, floating CTA, and chatbot as-is — do not rebuild those.

components_NOT_to_reuse: .hero (homepage gradient hero with image-slider) — treatment page hero is simpler, see hero_banner below
.stats / .stats__grid (homepage trust-number band) — not part of this page's anatomy
.services-grid / .service-card (homepage icon-card grid) — replaced by article-style content blocks
.doctor-card as a standalone mid-page section — instead surface reviewer credit as a small inline badge (reviewed_by_badge), full doctor bio can stay linked/footer-referenced only

page_anatomy.description: Modeled directly on the clovedental.in dental-implant page section order and purpose. Apply this same skeleton to any future treatment (teeth-whitening, braces, root-canal) by swapping content only.

sections.purpose: Compact intro banner — NOT the homepage gradient hero. Simple: eyebrow label, H1 treatment name, one-line subtitle, single primary CTA ('Talk to a Dentist' / 'Book an Appointment'). Optional small supporting image right, not a slider.
sections.layout: two-column on desktop (text left ~60%, image right ~40%), stacks on mobile
sections.background: off-white or primary-pale (light, not the dark gradient) — reuse --primary-pale or --off-white-elevated

sections.purpose: 'What is [Treatment]?' — plain-language explainer, 1-3 paragraphs, max-width narrow column for readability (like container--narrow)
sections.new_class_suggestion: .article-section (generic wrapper reused for most text sections below)

sections.purpose: 'Why [Treatment]?' — consequences of not treating / problem context. Bulleted list styled as warning-toned items (icon + text), reusing --error accent sparingly for icons only, not full alarming red blocks.
Optional single inline stat callout embedded in prose (e.g. '98% success rate'), NOT a full-width stats band like the homepage. Small pull-quote style card.

Optional: 'X vs Y' comparison (e.g. Bridges vs Implants) — only include if a natural alternative exists for the treatment. Two-column table, header row in dark-navy, right/recommended column subtly highlighted with a bright-blue left border.
Positive checklist of benefits, check-icon in --success, light pale-background list items

Multi-stage procedure explainer (e.g. Placing Implant -> Abutment -> Crown). Each stage gets its own sub-heading + 2-4 paragraphs, NOT the homepage's short 3-step icon grid — this is longer-form with real explanatory depth per stage.
sections.layout: vertical stacked stages, each with a numbered badge (reuse .step__num circle styling) + heading + prose

sections.purpose: Post-procedure care instructions — bulleted list, calmer tone, can reuse .benefit-list styling or a dedicated variant

Pricing transparency block — price range, brief justification of value, disclaimer, CTA button. Card-style, dark-navy background with white text OR primary-pale card — choose whichever reads cleaner against the rest of the page (page is otherwise light, so a dark card here creates nice contrast, similar to how clove uses a distinct cost block).
Small credibility line: 'Medically reviewed by Dr. X on [date]' — pill-style badge, reuse rating-badge-like treatment
Reuse existing .testimonials/.testimonial classes as-is — no change needed
Final conversion push before footer — short heading + primary button, reuse .btn--primary

typography_rules_for_this_page.reading_column_max_width: 720px, centered, for all prose sections (what_is_it, why_it_matters, benefits, procedure stages, aftercare)
typography_rules_for_this_page.body_line_height: 1.7 (slightly more relaxed than homepage's 1.6, since this is long-form reading)
typography_rules_for_this_page.h2_style: same as .section__header h2 token values, left-aligned instead of centered for article sections

content_schema_placeholder.note: Per-treatment content JSON — pass alongside this file. Structure content, don't worry about writing it all here; Cursor has creative liberty to draft real copy in dental-implant.html directly.

example.hero_subtitle: A permanent, natural-looking solution for missing teeth.

notes_for_cursor: Content depth and exact copy are yours to write with creative liberty — match the thoroughness and tone of a real clinic educational page (clear, reassuring, medically accurate, patient-facing), similar in spirit and length to clovedental.in's dental-implant page, but ORIGINAL wording, not copied.
You may add new CSS classes to the EXISTING style.css file only — append them in a clearly commented new section. Do not create a second stylesheet.
Reuse header, footer, floating CTA, phone modal, appointment modal, chatbot, buttons, and FAQ accordion exactly as already implemented — these are shared site chrome.
Keep all colors, fonts, radii, and shadows sourced from the existing CSS custom properties — no new hex values.
This page should read as a long-form educational article with a light, clean background — not a repeat of the homepage's marketing-landing-page layout.
